build_transformer_encoder: build a TransformerEncoder with specified vocabulary size, embedding, and padding index for the generator model
build_transformer_decoder: build a TransformerDecoder with the given options and shared embedding for the generator model
reorder_encoder_states: reorder encoder states and attention masks by batch indices during beam search decoding
reorder_decoder_incremental_state: reorder decoder incremental state across layers by batch indices for beam search
compute_output_logits: compute output logits by projecting decoder tensor through embedding weights and masking start tokens
